Confirmation.description:
An internal maintenance record (decision 0013): the kind of source and the day it was
recorded, never who or which document. The app never shows it.

ConfirmationKind.description:
What a step or light note was confirmed against (decision 0013, which defines each kind).
The list grows by adding a kind there and here.

oneOf.description: Matches the aircraft developer's documentation for the simulated aircraft.
Matches an official public document from an aviation authority.

confirmed_by.description: Internal record of what this note was confirmed against (decision 0013).

locator.description: `<panel>/<section>/<label>/<n>`, where n counts items with that label from 1.

normal.description: True when seeing this light is normal.
